notes: Survival leads because the turn the prompt is built around is the animals going hostile at night and the answer sets the goal as escaping the jungle — threat evasion with an exit, not disaster survival in place. Adventure is named second since the first two minutes are a real peaceful exploration phase with feeding spots to find, and losing it would lose half the prompt. Escape on warren-looping because a player fleeing animal AI must never be cornered by a dead end; that P6 is a structural law and stays, while the preset's building-interior was dropped because a jungle has no shelters to enter and nothing here goes indoors. Decided without a user: the angry animals are hostile actors (spawner-npc) rather than a damaging region, the day-to-night turn happens on one map so nothing forces P4, 'make it a 4d model' was read as stylised 3D with no layout consequence, and the feeding spots have no option in either loaded file so they are carried here as a placement request for simple feeding stations spread along the loops.
